limitations: No packet exists in this source review; static packet transport review remains required before any provider push.
Fresh quota/provider status, source seal, device identity, registry slug, and root pre-push admission remain dynamic root/operator gates.
scope: Exact frozen V9 profile source, memory-domain and source-packet-builder map review. This is not packet transport approval or provider/profile admission.

verification.code_scope: V8-to-V9 worker diff is limited to the exact CUDA/NVML domain validation/receipt fields, new helper/tests, V9 packet identity/path, and root-authorized 1,700-second cap; existing scientific and other resource thresholds remain unchanged.
verification.conservative_free: min(CUDA free, NVML physical total - NVML used); the unchanged 6-GiB floor applies to this conservative value.
verification.domain_rule: Exact selected UUID; require 0 < CUDA free <= CUDA usable total <= NVML physical total; CUDA property and mem_get_info totals must be equal. Invalid/missing values fail closed.
verification.no_pid_bound: max(NVML physical total - CUDA free, NVML physical total - NVML free), equivalent to physical total minus the smaller observed free domain; preserves driver/runtime overhead and remains subject to the unchanged 3,000,000,000-byte cap.
verification.scientific_and_input_path: Profile-only recipe, data/fold/hash/membership checks, digest-handoff identity/registry binding, loader-count and numerical guards are retained; no fit, score, metric, or training recipe was added.
verification.startup_and_live_gates: Startup environment/resource snapshots are atomically written before active resource enforcement; the selected exact UUID and both domains are checked at startup and refreshed during live guards. Query/domain errors abort; bounded raw diagnostics are retained.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=<candidate> scripts/limited .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_gpu_memory_domains.py tests/test_digest_handoff_integration.py tests/test_profile_guards.py
